content:
alyssa (sales): PivotalBank sent the RFP back. They want a 2-week POC: on-prem/private deploy, HSM/KMS (FIPS 140-2), and a latency SLO of <50ms p95 for short chat. Also asked for committed capacity pricing. Can we sketch a plan today?

devin (solutions): Key risks: on-prem HSM integration, realistic latency depends on their RPS and seq lengths, and we need legal to sign NDA before infra access.

samir (eng): For 32-token responses, <50ms p95 is feasible with dedicated A10s and int8 quantization, but need QPS and prompt distribution. HSM: we support KMIP and CloudHSM; on-prem HSM requires network connectivity and a connector.

maria-ops (solutions-engineer): Drafting POC plan: Day0-2 staging smoke; Day3-9 Private deploy in their VPC with customer KMS stub; Day10-12 perf runs + report. Include runbook and RFI appendix.

alyssa (sales): They want to start Tue. Can we hand off Wed? They'll require NDA immediately.

devin (solutions): I can draft pricing bands: POC transient rate (50% off list) and committed tiers: 4/16/64 GPU buckets with per-GPU monthly and committed discount. Will produce CSV.

samir (eng): I'll build a one-page capability matrix: rows for redwood-7B/13B/70B, columns for quantization, p95 latency (32/64 tokens), throughput per GPU, cost $/token (committed vs burst). Example line: "redwood-13B | int8 | 35ms p95 | 120 req/s per A10 | $0.0009/token (committed)"

maria-ops (solutions-engineer): Security Q: do we ever hold keys for Private?

samir (eng): No. Customer manages keys for Private. We store only encrypted references. Hosted can use Redwood KMS optionally. I'll add exact wording for the questionnaire.

alyssa (sales): Ops SLA ask: can we offer 99.9% control plane + response SLAs for runbook steps?

maria-ops (solutions-engineer): Yes for control plane. For on-prem infra we note it's best-effort unless they buy managed Dedicated nodes. We'll call this out in RFI.

devin (solutions): Maria, list infra items to request: HSM vendor/model/firmware, VPC CIDR, allowed ports, expected peak RPS, sample prompt set for compliance tests.

maria-ops (solutions-engineer): Will request all that and include a sample network diagram.

ops-bot: Ticket created: #POC-5827 assigned to maria-ops, samir, devin. Due 2024-11-08.

alyssa (sales): I'll request prompts and legal contacts in handoff. Please drop RFI appendix + capability one-pager by EOD PST.

devin (solutions): Uploading initial pricing CSV and short POC terms in thread (will send attachments).

samir (eng): Also note: quantization may affect output quality. We'll include a small evaluation matrix (BLEU/ROUGE-ish + hallucination check) for each model config.

maria-ops (solutions-engineer): Drafts uploaded: RFI_answers_draft.docx and capability_onepager_v1.pdf. Review and flag edits.

alyssa (sales): Thanks team. Once legal signs NDA, I'll share infra contacts and kick off the schedule. :thumbsup:
